svg.text: ① GSP: pʲ = b⁽ʲ⁺¹⁾ — the price is pinned to the next bid

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ② VCG: pʲ is a weighted average of all lower bids, inside this range

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GSP takes the left end of the range (the highest of the lower bids); VCG takes a weighted average inside it, so the price is strictly lower.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weights wₖ = (αᵏ⁻¹ − αᵏ)/αʲ are all nonnegative and sum to (αʲ − αⁿ)/αʲ ≤ 1.
